metadata: Editorial biographies written from archived league evidence. Trade picks are provisional raw direct-edge candidates, not certified best/worst positions or full transaction valuations. Waiver awards withheld until transaction provenance confirmed.

Stilly.biography: A championship-winning franchise with 1 documented title, Stilly has built a reputation as the portfolio manager. The franchise résumé is highlighted by 2023 champion · 2024 runner-up. Its player history features Jayden Daniels, Josh Allen, David Montgomery, each a distinctive part of the team's recorded lineup story. Constantly consolidates and repairs the roster in-season. Best when turning several good assets into one elite one, or escaping a draft mistake before the market fully collapses. This profile separates championship results from incomplete historical scoring and trade evidence.

Tom.biography: A championship-winning franchise with 4 documented titles, Tom has built a reputation as the championship standard.
